All hard invariants of the fix hold: no 'Unknown' bucket, no dead rows, kpis.top_brand is null (never 'Unknown'), KPIs sane, product brand projections reconcile with top_brands (excluding legitimately-dropped zero-activity rows). iter73g Discounts regression guard also passes: /api/discounts/top-pct?days=90 returns 30 rows in <5s.

minor.issue: Preview DB has 40 products all with qty_sold_est=0 and revenue_est=0, so top_brands is empty and the market_share_pct sum test and search-by-brand test are auto-skipped. Not a code bug — seed-data limitation. If a stronger end-to-end verification is desired, seed at least a few products with real sales.

critical_code_review_comments: _insights_sales_compute (server.py L3924-4058) — the aggregation loop calls extract_brand_smart twice per product (once in _row_brand to stamp p['brand'], and again in the accumulator). This is defensive but O(2N). Cache the canonical value on the product row and reuse. Cosmetic, not blocking.

top_brands is capped at [:20] but market_share_pct is computed against ALL kept-brand revenue (correct). If there are >20 buckets the displayed rows will not sum to 100 — consider showing the '# other brands' remainder to preserve the '100%' user-mental-model.
kpis.top_brand condition uses `top_brands[0]['revenue_est'] > 0` — good defensive check, prevents surfacing a top brand from a zero-revenue leader if the dead-row filter is ever relaxed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8 passed, 2 skipped due to seed data limitations, 0 failed)

rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/insights/sales bucketed every un-brand-resolvable product into a synthetic 'Unknown' row that dominated the leaderboard (77.6% market share, 38957 units in the client screenshot) because (a) products without brand tags were still counted, (b) Arabic/English aliases of the same brand were double-counted as separate rows, (c) market_share_pct denominator was the full catalog revenue including the Unknown bloat. Fix (server.py L4001-4046): drop unresolvable brands entirely, canonicalize via extract_brand_smart into single buckets, drop zero-activity rows, and compute market_share_pct against the SUM of kept-brand revenue only. Verified: top_brands never contains 'Unknown', kpis.top_brand is null when no resolvable+active brand exists (never the string 'Unknown'), no dead rows, brand keys are case-unique.
